finding: Final completion sample precedes drop(admission). Scheduling delay after the sample can be included in actual admission holding time but omitted from service_budget_met.
impact: The diagnostic alone cannot establish the actual release-time premise required by the FIFO/readiness bound. This audit does not demonstrate conflicting acceptance or bypass of the live effect fence.
required_repair: Sample service completion after releasing the finalizer admission share; retain ownership through any outstanding durable closure. Account separately for queue dispatch/resumption and cancellation paths.
qualification: Current process campaign remains unchanged and live. Its final evidence must not be presented as an actual admission-release bound.
